learning_objective: 🎯 Explore how different sounds and melodies can make us feel happy, sad, or excited, and learn to express your feelings through music!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like colors on a canvas, music can change how we feel! A fast, bouncy tune can make you feel super happy and energetic, while a slow, soft song might make you feel calm or thoughtful.
Tempo is how fast or slow a piece of music is played. Fast tempos bring excitement and make us want to dance, while slow tempos help us relax, breathe deeply, and dream.
You do not have to be a professional musician to be creative! Humming your own tune, tapping a rhythm on your desk, or making up a silly song is a wonderful way to let your inner feelings out.

fun_activity.title: 🎧 Emotion Playlist Art
fun_activity.instructions: Listen to three very different songs. Grab some paper and crayons, and draw abstract shapes or use colors that match exactly how each song makes you feel!

quick_recap: ⭐ Music has the magical power to change our mood and help us express hidden feelings.
⭐ Fast and slow tempos tell different emotional stories to our ears and our hearts.
